resources.string: While dragging an app, drop it on “Split” to open it beside a second app. Also adds “Open in split screen” to the app menu.
A third app joins split screen as a third pane instead of floating (Recents and app pairs). Needs Folark\'s Vector module with System UI in its scope
Active: System UI takes a third pane
Not seen yet: add System UI to Folark\'s scope in Vector, then restart the phone. Until then a third app floats
Ask System UI to actually tile the third app. Leave off if picking a third app crashes System UI — the third app then floats instead, which is reliable on every ROM.
Dragging an app to a screen edge, in Recents and from the taskbar
Android\'s split commands only (needs the one-time ADB grant).
The Vector module\'s native split first; Android\'s split commands when System UI turns a request down or the module isn\'t running.
Android\'s split commands through root, no ADB grant needed.
The Vector module when it runs in System UI, else Android\'s split commands (with the ADB grant, or root).
Shows each part split screen needs (ADB grant, root, the Vector module, split events) and which way a split is made now
System UI restarted at %1$s right after a split request, so the split commands are used instead. Tap to allow native split again.
Where a dragged app can be dropped: in Recents, from the taskbar, and on the home screen\'s drop bar (left, right, three). Tap a zone to switch it off or on
A short vibration when the dragged app reaches a drop zone
An \"Undo split\" pill on the taskbar for 5 seconds after a split forms; tap it to go back to the app that was there first
The drawer that opens beside the app you dragged to an edge
Your drawer folders as the first row; their apps aren\'t listed again below
Previews are small screenshots of the apps and need root; without root the row shows icons.
Apps you mark as favorites, first in the picker. Long-press an app there to add it
The apps the dragged app was last put beside. Remembered on this phone only
Clears the list the Paired before row is made from
A Peek switch at the top of the picker opens your pick as peek view (needs Folark\'s Vector module)
Long-press an app in the picker to open it as a pop-up or full screen instead, or to add it to favorites
The icon you tap grows to fill the picker\'s half, then the app opens there.
The app fades in over the picker.
The taskbar\'s split menu offers each app 67 %, besides half and half and peek. Needs Folark\'s Vector module in System UI

When you open an app you\'ve often put beside another one lately (3 times in 30 days), a pill offers that app for a few seconds. Inner screen only. Passed over 3 times, that pair isn\'t offered again. Uses the pair history kept on the phone
Divider stays where you let go

Drag the divider to any size, for two apps and three, and it stays there instead of jumping to half and half or peek view. Near the screen\'s edge peek view and closing still work (needs Folark\'s Vector module)
Faint lines at ⅓, ½ and ⅔ while you drag; let go near one and the divider lands on it (marks need "Display over other apps")
Tick at ⅓, ½ and ⅔
A light haptic tick when the dragged divider passes a mark
Keep sizes when turning or folding
Motorola resets a split to its fixed sizes after a turn or fold; this keeps yours
Remember sizes per set of apps
Apps you had side by side open again at the sizes they had last time
Show where a drag can go
While you drag text or a picture out of an app in split screen, the panes light up (needs "Display over other apps")
Fling peek view\'s divider hard towards the strip to close the app peeking in
A third app joining a split makes three equal thirds (33 / 33 / 33) instead of Motorola\'s carousel, where one app shrinks to a strip (needs Folark\'s Vector module)
The split divider rests at 33 %, 50 % and 67 %, the sizes Motorola\'s split screen lays apps out at (needs Folark\'s Vector module; from the next split)
Come up at a set time
Choose the weekdays — none chosen means every day
Notifications are off for Folark: a pair that comes due while another app is open cannot be shown
Your scheduled pair is ready — tap to open it
